name: Thomas Attractor
recipe: Thomas' cyclically-symmetric attractor: x'=sin(y)-b x (and cyclic) traces a beautiful labyrinthine 3D lattice of looping tubes with perfect 3-fold symmetry. Iterate, rotate the 3D projection on K.t so it turns, drift b so it opens/closes between a tight knot and a sprawling web. Default COLORFUL: density+depth log-mapped through an iq palette (teal->gold) glowing on dark, luminance ~0.12-0.35. IMPORTANT: accumulate MANY iterates (40-80k/frame) with bright additive splats so it is NOT a sparse near-empty frame.
kernel: iterate Thomas ODE (dt~0.05, b~0.19) 40-80k steps/frame; rotate (x,y,z) by K.t-driven 3D rotation, project, splat into a coarse density buffer shaded by z; log-map palette LUT, upscale. Continuous rotation = motion. Keep it bright and full.
style: labyrinth (default, teal->gold). Also: plasma, ember, ice, pencil (named mono).

name: Barnsley Fern
recipe: The Barnsley fern: an iterated-function-system (chaos game, 4 affine maps) that grows the iconic self-similar fern frond, fractal leaflets budding from the stem. It DRAWS ITSELF (progressive point accumulation) then a new variant fern (drift the IFS coefficients on K.section) grows in. Slowly sway on K.t. Default COLORFUL: fern in luminous greens with hue-shift by height (deep green base -> chartreuse tips) on dark, luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills a tall frond region — mirror/duplicate a couple of fronds to fill width.
kernel: accumulate ~30-60k chaos-game points (Barnsley's 4 weighted affine maps) into a persistent buffer each frame with additive green splats; drift map coefficients on K.section for variant ferns; sway/rotate slightly on K.t; draw 2-3 offset fronds to fill the frame. Growing accumulation = motion.
style: botanical (default, green height-gradient). Also: autumn (amber fern), bioluminescent (teal glow), frost (white/blue), ink (named mono, sumi fern on cream).

name: Burning Ship Fractal
recipe: The Burning Ship fractal: like Mandelbrot but with absolute-values in the iteration, producing the eerie fractal 'ship' with antenna masts and self-similar armadas along the real axis. Slowly pan/zoom into the rigging on K.t and cycle the palette so the flames flicker. Default COLORFUL: smooth-iteration through a fire palette (black->deep red->orange->white flames) with the ship silhouette, luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: per-pixel buffer (<=200 wide): iterate z=(|Re z|+i|Im z|)^2+c, smooth escape count -> fire palette LUT; interior tinted dark (not pure black). Pan/zoom the window slowly on K.t into an interesting region; palette cycles on K.t. Recompute each frame.
style: flames (default, black->red->orange->white). Also: ice (blue/white), toxic (green), spectral (rainbow bands), etched (named mono).

name: Faraday Waves
recipe: Faraday waves: a vertically-vibrated fluid surface spontaneously patterns into a shimmering lattice of standing-wave cells — squares, stripes, hexagons and oscillons that pulse and re-tile with the drive. Distinct from Chladni (this is a fluid surface, undulating). Default COLORFUL: surface height/slope shaded like backlit water (caustic highlights on a teal/indigo surface) with the cell lattice bright, luminance ~0.2-0.5, edge-to-edge, perpetually oscillating.
kernel: a standing-wave height field = sum of a few counter-propagating wave modes on a lattice whose amplitudes are parametrically driven (oscillate on K.t at ~half the drive), pattern (square/hex/stripe) switches on K.section; shade by height+gradient (specular caustic highlights) into a coarse buffer, upscale. Intrinsic oscillation = motion.
style: backlit-water (default, teal/indigo + caustic highlights). Also: mercury (silver), thermal, oil-film (iridescent), mono (named, height greyscale).

name: Wave Function Collapse
recipe: Wave-Function-Collapse tiling: an adjacency-constrained solver collapses a grid of tiles one lowest-entropy cell at a time so compatible edges connect into a coherent generated pattern (pipes/circuit/knot/maze paths). Watch it COLLAPSE cell-by-cell (progressive), then reset and regenerate a new one. Default COLORFUL: the connective tile-paths as bright multi-hue tracks over a dark grid, uncollapsed cells shimmering faintly. Luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: grid of cells each with a possibility set + a small tileset with edge-adjacency rules in S; each frame collapse a few lowest-entropy cells (pick + propagate constraints), draw collapsed tiles' connective paths (arcs/lines colored by tile) and faint superposition for uncollapsed; regenerate on K.section. Progressive collapse = motion.
style: pipes (default, bright path tracks on dark). Also: circuit (copper), knot (woven), stained-glass (filled), mono (named).

name: Spectrogram Waterfall
recipe: A scrolling spectrogram / audio-waterfall: frequency on one axis, time scrolling on the other, magnitude as a hot colormap — the classic FFT waterfall. Drive it from A.fft when audio is present, but ALSO from a rich synthetic spectrum (drifting formants/harmonics/sweeps on K.t) so it is beautiful and alive in silence. Default COLORFUL: magma/inferno colormap (black->purple->orange->white) ridges scrolling, luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: a persistent buffer scrolled by 1-2 px/frame; each frame synthesize a new column spectrum = sum of drifting formant peaks + sweeps + noise floor (K.t), blended with A.fft on top; map magnitude->magma LUT, draw the new column at the edge; scroll. Continuous scroll = motion.
style: magma (default, inferno colormap). Also: viridis, ice (blue), phosphor (green waterfall), mono (named, greyscale).

name: Aeolian Dunes
recipe: Aeolian sand ripples / dunes: wind transports sand into migrating ripple trains and barchan dune crests that slowly crawl downwind, crestlines branching and merging — a self-organizing granular landscape seen from above with raking light. Default COLORFUL: warm desert sand (ochre/umber) with raking-light shadows picking out the ripple crests, or a false-color height map; luminance ~0.25-0.55, edge-to-edge, ripples crawl on K.t.
kernel: a coarse sand-height field in S evolved by a simple aeolian rule (sand hops downwind from windward to lee slopes; add ripple-instability) OR a synthetic migrating-ripple field = layered anisotropic noise scrolling on K.t; shade by height + a low raking-light gradient (dot(normal,lightdir)) for crest shadows, upscale. Crawling = motion.
style: desert (default, ochre sand + raking shadows). Also: dune-night (blue moonlit), thermal-height, mars (red), contour (named mono, height lines).

name: Chua Double-Scroll
recipe: Chua's circuit double-scroll attractor: the famous electronic-chaos attractor with two spiral 'scrolls' the trajectory hops between, tracing a butterfly of dense filament windings. Rotate the 3D projection on K.t; drift a parameter so the scrolls breathe. Default COLORFUL: density log-mapped through a palette (magenta scroll / cyan scroll / gold bridge) glowing on dark, luminance ~0.12-0.35. Accumulate MANY iterates so it is dense, not sparse.
kernel: iterate Chua ODE (piecewise-linear diode nonlinearity) 40-80k steps/frame; rotate+project to 2D, splat into density buffer colored by which scroll / by z; log-map palette LUT, upscale. Continuous rotation = motion. Keep bright + full.
style: double-scroll (default, magenta/cyan/gold). Also: plasma, ember, ice, pencil (named mono).

name: Mandelbrot Deep Zoom
recipe: An endless deep zoom into the Mandelbrot boundary: the view continuously magnifies toward a pre-chosen interesting point (seahorse valley / mini-brot / spiral) revealing ever-new self-similar detail, palette cycling as it descends. Reset to a new target on K.section. Distinct from the static mandelbrot asset — this is a perpetual zoom. Default COLORFUL: smooth-iteration through a cycling spectral/electric palette, luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame. Keep zoom moderate so it never pixelates to flat color (cap depth, reset before precision breaks).
kernel: per-pixel buffer (<=200 wide): center on a seeded interesting c0, scale = exp(-K.t*rate) (wrapping/resetting on K.section to a new c0), iterate z=z^2+c with iteration count scaling as you zoom, smooth-color through a K.t-cycling palette LUT. Continuous zoom = strong motion.
style: electric (default, cycling spectral). Also: ember, ice, psychedelic, etched (named mono).

name: Aizawa Attractor
recipe: FIX of a version that rendered NEAR-EMPTY and STATIC (a few specks, motion 0.0021). ROOT CAUSE: too few iterates accumulated + splats too dim + rotation too slow to register over 8s. Re-author so it is DENSE and BRIGHT and MOVING: accumulate 50-90k iterates PER FRAME into the density buffer with bright additive splats (tone-map log-density so the whole spherical-shell-with-spiral-tube form GLOWS and fills a good part of the frame, luminance ~0.15-0.35). Drive continuous motion with a fast-enough INCOMMENSURATE 3D rotation (sum of two rotation rates so it never re-phases at 8s). Default COLORFUL: indigo shell -> gold polar spiral.
kernel: iterate the Aizawa ODE (a=.95,b=.7,c=.6,d=3.5,e=.25,f=.1; dt~.01) 50-90k steps/frame from a fixed start (discard first ~200 as burn-in); rotate (x,y,z) by TWO incommensurate K.t rotation rates, project, splat bright into a coarse density buffer shaded by z-depth; tone-map log(1+density) through an iq palette LUT, upscale. Must be dense/bright/rotating.
style: cosmic (default, indigo shell/gold spiral). Also: plasma (magenta/cyan), ember, ice, pencil (named mono).
